title.en: Chapter 15 — Why He Did Not Come Home

book_meta.author: Arthur Conan Doyle
book_meta.status: public domain — all Holmes entered the US public domain by 2023

sentences.ar: قال الرجل: كنت صحفي، وجربت الشحادة مرة لمقال.
sentences.en: The man said: I was a journalist, and I tried begging once for an article.

sentences.ar: بيوم واحد، جمعت أكتر من راتب أسبوع.
sentences.en: In one day, I collected more than a week’s salary.
And I could not go back from that.
He said: my wife thinks me a respectable merchant.

sentences.ar: هولمز قال: إذا وقفت من اليوم، الشرطة بتنسى.
sentences.en: Holmes said: if you stop today, the police will forget.

sentences.ar: وبعد ما طلعنا، قال لي: مش كل سر جريمة.
sentences.en: And after we left, he said to me: not every secret is a crime.
